thread:
Sam Li: Heads-up: onboarding schedule for new on-call shadow (Lee). Need to coordinate primary/secondary handoffs and make sure coverage nights are filled. Quick plan below.

Marta Chen: +1. When does Lee start shadowing?

Sam Li: Lee is available next week Tue/Wed/Thu nights 22:00-02:00 PST. Looking for a primary/secondary pair for each slot. Prefer Marta/James to lead first week.

James Ortiz: I can do Tue night (primary) and take Wednesday backup. Can cover Thu morning if needed but prefer not to do two nights in a row.

Marta Chen: I can be Tue secondary and Thu primary. That leaves Wed night open for a primary.

Lee Park: thanks! I can shadow any of those nights. What should I watch for during pages? Any quick runbook pointers?

Sam Li: Quick checklist for shadowing:
```
1) Read runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Oncall+Onboarding
2) Join PagerDuty: accept rotation
3) Join #eng-oncall voice on incidents (zoom link in runbook)
4) Observe Ack -> Triage -> Mitigation -> Postmortem steps
```

Sam Li: Also run these quick commands locally during a page:
```bash
# list active alerts
rdctl alert list --filter "status:triggered"
# tail app logs
rdctl logs tail api-prod --since 10m
```

oncall-bot: Reminder: Lee Park added to shadow rotation for 2025-04-08T22:00:00Z (automated)

James Ortiz: There's a coverage gap Wed 22:00-02:00. I can pick it up if someone swaps Thu with me.

Marta Chen: I can swap Thu with James. Confirmed.

Sam Li: Great. Final schedule:
- Tue 22:00-02:00 PST: Primary James Ortiz / Secondary Marta Chen / Shadow Lee Park
- Wed 22:00-02:00 PST: Primary James Ortiz / Secondary open -> @sre-team ask for volunteers
- Thu 22:00-02:00 PST: Primary Marta Chen / Secondary Sam Li / Shadow Lee Park

Sam Li: Action items:
- @Marta confirm you're ok to be secondary Tue and primary Thu
- @James confirm you want Wed primary as well after swap
- @Lee Park I will DM calendar invites + a short 1:1 walkthrough before Tue
- I'll add a pointer in the runbook about shadow expectations

Marta Chen: Confirmed for those roles.

James Ortiz: Confirmed. I can cover Wed primary.

Sam Li: Cool. @oncall-bot please update rotation metadata and ping the SRE rota if any nights remain unfilled.

sre-rotations-bot: Noted. Wed night still shows as 'open-secondary'. Posting to #eng-sre for volunteers.

incident-bot: If a SEV1 fires while shadowing, protocol: primary acknowledges within 2m, shadow monitors, escalate to @engineering-manager if not mitigated in 15m.

Lee Park: Thanks all. One last question: where do we record lessons from a page while shadowing?

Sam Li: Add notes to the incident thread (use "Lessons for oncall" tag) and we'll copy to the runbook. Also a quick 15-min sync after the shift.

Marta Chen: Can I get a short template for the post-shift sync?

Sam Li: Yep — will DM template. Template includes: timeline, actions taken, open items, follow-ups, and suggested runbook edits.

Sam Li: I'll send invites and update runbook tonight. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
